question: How many people were killed in the fire at a shopping mall in Karachi on January 17, 2026?

steps.content:
[2026 Gul Plaza Shopping Mall fire - Wikipedia] On 17 January 2026, a fire at the Gul Plaza shopping mall in Karachi, Pakistan, killed 80 people and injured over 20. The fire started after an unattended child accidentally set some artificial flowers alight with a matchstick in a shop on the ground floor. The fire spread rapidly through an air-conditioning duct to the rest of the building.
